note: The session's shared web-search allowance was already spent when this part began, and many county, city and party sites did not resolve on this machine's network, so most findings come from the Kentucky State Board of Elections' official county recaps (2022 and 2024, read from the copies the kit keeps) and a few official pages fetched directly. The 2022 recaps of Bell, Breathitt, Clay, Estill, Gallatin, Livingston, Owen, Powell, Trimble, Wolfe, Barren, Fayette, Allen and Washington counties are scans with no text and could not be read. Stephanie Aschmann Spires is listed on the Fayette County Democratic Party's 2026 Action Center (already in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json as listed, not endorsed), but the page links her name to a LinkedIn profile, which is a social profile and not a campaign website, so no website is recorded. Hancock County's 2022 recap prints no party on the constable contest, so no past_party is recorded for Josh L Estes.
